compute_shortest_paths: compute shortest path lengths from a source node to all reachable nodes in a graph adjacency matrix
run_bfs_with_cutoff: run breadth-first search to find shortest paths from a source node with a maximum depth cutoff
connect_disconnected_components: connect disconnected components in a sparse graph by adding edges between closest pairs of samples
fix_graph_connectivity: fix a disconnected sample graph to ensure all nodes belong to a single connected component
build_single_source_path_length: build a dictionary mapping reachable nodes to their shortest path length from a given source node
